basics.name: Alex Morgan
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8 years of experience building web, mobile and backend products. Leads API and integration work end to end, from design through launch, and mentors engineers across teams. Works daily in TypeScript, Node.js, React and PostgreSQL on AWS, with a growing focus on AI features and developer tooling. Active open-source contributor.

work.name: Northwind Labs
highlights: Lead a team of 5 building the payments and invoicing platform used by 4,000+ businesses, built on Node.js, React and PostgreSQL.
Designed an event-driven integration layer connecting 12 accounting and ERP systems, cutting partner onboarding from weeks to days.
Introduced contract testing and staged rollouts, reducing production incidents by 40% year over year.

work.name: Brightline
highlights: Built the React Native app for a 200k-user booking platform, from first release to a 4.8-star App Store rating.
Moved core services from a monolith to containerized services on AWS, halving deployment time.

work.name: Freelance
highlights: Delivered web and mobile apps for small businesses, including point-of-sale and inventory systems.

volunteer.summary: Mentor teenagers learning to build their first web apps in weekly sessions.
